requirements.TowersOfHanoiArbitrary: Given source and target partitions of the same integer disk labels into three pegs, return legal moves [from_peg, to_peg] that transform source to target. Peg indices are 0, 1, 2. Each peg stores increasing labels; append moves must preserve that order. Use the supplied labels; the disk count is not fixed.
requirements.Sudoku: Given an 81-character Sudoku puzzle (digits 1-9 and _ for blanks), return exactly 81 digits preserving all givens. Each row, column and 3x3 square must contain all digits 1-9.

contracts.Sudoku:
def _grading_contract(answer, args):
    assert isinstance(answer, str) and len(answer) == 81
